name: Goblin Swarm plan
summary: Make more Goblins than the opponent can answer one at a time, multiply them, and cash the width in with effects that count Units.

packages.label: Token engine
packages.rationale: Every card here is authored as a Swarm Generator: without them the deck has no board to be wide with, and no other package produces bodies from nothing.

packages.label: Tribal multipliers
packages.rationale: The Multiplier and Tribal Engine cards are worth nothing on an empty board and are the difference between a wide board and a winning one, so they belong with the engine rather than with the payoff.

packages.label: Width payoff
packages.rationale: Each of these scales on how many Units are already out. Held without the engine they are blank; that dependence is exactly what a plan exists to record.

packages.label: Early curve
packages.rationale: Plain one- and two-cost bodies. Interchangeable by design, which is why this package is not core: a search may replace any of them without changing what the deck is.

packages.label: Reach and removal
packages.rationale: The deck's only answers to a blocker it cannot attack past. Not core: the archetype survives losing them, and the search should be free to try that.
